PEOPLE / PLACE · An exploration of population & geography
READING THE ATLAS

People shape the map.

This is a gridded population cartogram, not a geographic density map. Each tile represents approximately 100,000 people; regional totals are rounded to the nearest tile. Positions are schematic.

Illustrative dataset. The built-in rounded regional figures are demonstration estimates at 2000, 2010, 2020 and 2024, with linear interpolation between anchors. They are not a verified statistical series and should not be used for analysis.

Sejong appears from 2012. Historical boundaries are not harmonized. For authoritative data, use KOSIS or SGIS census data.

Bring your own annual data

CSV columns: year,region,population. Use the English region names in the download. Include all 17 regions for each year (Sejong may be 0). Imported data stays in this browser session.
